strings: Expansion corner symbol present; used solely as B&C exclusion exemplar. No gameplay imported.
Full image independently received and visually inspected at original resolution in this audit.
Expansion corner symbol present; used solely as B&C exclusion exemplar. No sinking-board procedure required.
Target Spirit adds 2 destroyed Presence into one land within Range 2 from user Presence; if added, damage each building there; threshold +4 total in that land. No expansion corner.
Dahan-targeted land; 1 Damage and Defend 2 per Dahan; optional threshold Push up to 2 with each Dahan carrying its own Defend. No expansion corner.
Spirit target provides Defend 2 in each of its lands, consistent with current FAQ following current Presence. No expansion corner.
Three Fear levels grant island-wide Defend based on Dahan; current counts checked when relevant. No expansion corner.
Move up to 5 Dahan to any land, Defend 5 there; threshold FIRST Gather up to 3 Dahan. Zero moved gives no destination; ordinary Move may stay in same land. No expansion corner.
Base grants Dahan +4 Health and leaves would-be-added Blight on card; threshold ignores Damage/Destroy and removes 1 Blight. No Remove/Replace protection. No expansion corner.
Push up to 2 Dahan, then conditional Fear if pushed into building land; FAQ locates that Fear in original target. No expansion corner.
Any Spirit target; self gains 1 Energy, another gains per card played; Repeat is no additional card play. No expansion corner.
2 Fear plus target Spirit may Push Explorer and Town from a land with its Presence; distinct from targeting a land. No expansion corner.
2 Fear is outside adjacent OR clauses; replace Town with Explorer OR City with Town. No expansion corner.
Defend 3; Dahan deal Ravage Damage simultaneously with Invaders. No second counterattack. No expansion corner.

Another Spirit gains 2 Energy; optional Town and up to 2 Dahan Push from one of its lands; Ocean user may send Dahan pushed to its Ocean into any Coastal land instead of Drowning. No expansion corner.
Power Fear in target land grants Defend per Fear; own 1 Fear included, dream-destruction Fear included, ordinary building destruction Fear excluded. No expansion corner.
Dahan condition permits Major gain; Forget this card grants Dahan-count Energy and optional immediate card play paying cost; OR Invader-condition 2 Fear. No expansion corner.
Slow; Mountain/Jungle target; if Explorers Push all, otherwise remove Blight. No free alternate choice with Explorers. No expansion corner.
Dahan each deal 1 Damage to a DIFFERENT Invader OR Push up to 3 Dahan. Excess cannot be concentrated. No expansion corner.
Base Fear/Damage then add Blight and destroy Dahan; threshold counts each Blight THEN present for added Fear/Damage. No expansion corner.
Targeting-only shared Presence; target gains first and user gains an unkept card; threshold gives both Energy and optional reciprocal gifts FROM HAND. No expansion corner.
Target gains 3 Energy and may Repeat a card by paying cost again; threshold 2 MORE cards paying costs; FAQ requires distinct cards. No expansion corner.
Coastal target from Sacred Site; base Damage and Dahan destruction; threshold each OTHER Coastal land on SAME board adds Fear/Damage/destruction. No expansion corner.
Corrected AFTER wording, 3 Fear; triggered Damage per Town/City/Dahan destroyed in target; threshold permits damage adjacent. No expansion corner.
Add Presence ignoring land-type restriction plus Defend; threshold conditional Fear and action skips, permits Ocean Inland placement and can reveal track Elements mid-Power. No expansion corner.
Fear per building this Power ACTUALLY destroys, capped; Damage to each Invader and threshold added total Damage. No expansion corner.
Ordered City/Town/Dahan replacements then Push ALL Explorers to as many distinct lands as possible; threshold BEFORE Push causes simultaneous mutual Invader Damage. No expansion corner.
Explorer destruction scales with Towns/Cities; level III then Town destruction per City. Current FAQ one action per building land applied. No expansion corner.
Each player different Dahan land; levels deal listed TOTAL Damage scaling with Dahan, not to each Invader. No expansion corner.
Level I Push/Gather choice; levels II/III each player different land, Gather UP TO 2, then Damage when Dahan present; zero Gather valid. No expansion corner.
Island-wide Coastal Defend; II prevents City Builds (whole qualifying Build skipped), III prevents all Coastal Builds. No expansion corner.
Level I no Build in City lands; II Coastal Town downgrade; III Coastal City OR Town downgrade. No expansion corner.
Fear and Dahan take no Damage FROM RAVAGING INVADERS this turn; no land protection and no general Damage/Destroy immunity. No expansion corner.
Spirit target +2 printed Range arrow with all THEIR Powers; Range bonus itself not further increased by other Range boosts. No expansion corner.

Pick one Growth group; double placement Range 2 then 0 can chain. Energy 1 to 5, card plays 2 to 6. Swiftness per current Air can make cards or innate Fast. Thundering Destruction has optional City INSTEAD, then additive building destruction, one target.
Setup 2 Presence in highest-numbered Sands; low complexity. Original art/layout and Growth/track geometry independently match 2017 photograph.

Pick one Growth group, including two Range-1 additions. Energy numbers not additive; Reclaim One on plays track. Wetland Presence counts as Sacred Site without extra disks. Massive Flooding higher INSTEAD levels replace prior Damage/Push, last deals to each Invader.
Setup 1 Presence highest-numbered Wetland; low complexity. Original artwork/layout independently corroborated by 2017 and small 2018 physical photos.

Pick one Growth group, each with placement; tracks Energy 2 to 8, plays 1 to 4. Sacred Sites give Defend 3 continuously. Gift of Strength grants free once-this-turn card Repeat; higher INSTEAD levels raise cost eligibility ceiling only.
Setup 3 Presence: 2 highest-numbered Mountain, 1 highest-numbered Jungle; low complexity. Printed identity/layout independently matches 2017 photo.

Pick one group; Range-3 placement group. Shadows of the Dahan costs 1 when using Power to ignore numeric Range, preserving other restrictions. Darkness thresholds sequential: Gather, destroy Explorers/Fear, then Damage/conditional Fear. Both lower thresholds share element types with nested amounts.
Setup 3 Presence: 2 highest-numbered Jungle, 1 land 5; overlapping setup instructions allowed. Low complexity. Printed identity/layout independently matches 2017 photo.

ALWAYS Range-2 Jungle/Wetland addition PLUS pick one group; temporary extra Card Play and printed track Elements visible. Optional Choke sacrifices Presence in Sacred Site per Ravage/Build. Steady Regeneration limited to Growth, Healthy free/Blighted 1 Energy per destroyed disk. Creepers has two explicit Repeat thresholds; All-Enveloping Green INSTEAD Defend then Blight removal.

Setup 2 Presence: highest-numbered Wetland and Jungle without Dahan, choice if tied. Moderate complexity. Printed original identity and all layout independently match 2017 photo and publisher 2017 prose.

Pick one Growth; separate two-card gains are distinct; double Dahan-land placement can chain. Track Elements plus Reclaim One. Presence may accompany each moved Dahan. Sworn to Victory Range-1 Presence loss after complete Ravage per Dahan destroyed by Invaders. Both innates have early optional Fast attribute threshold; Gather then Push; assault Town/City destructions additive not instead.
Setup 2 Presence one in each of two most-Dahan lands, choose ties legally. Moderate complexity. Printed identity independently matches 2017 photo and full publisher 2017 prose.

Pick ONE of three visually boxed groups, despite two-row arrangement. Mandatory Gather/Push 1 Presence EACH Ocean; separate unrestricted ANY-Ocean double additions; Coastal Range-1 group cannot treat Ocean as Wetland during Growth. Ocean rule forbids Inland add/move except explicit override; Powers/Blight treat occupied-board Ocean as Coastal Wetland. Drowning definition/exchange any time. Innate Fear additive; Drown City MAY INSTEAD then additive building Drown.
Setup 2 Presence: 1 Ocean and 1 chosen Coastal land on starting board. High complexity. Printed identity/layout independently matches 2017 left/middle photo. FAQ governs later timing refinements.

Pick one of four groups, including Reclaim ONE with Range-0 addition, and Range-4 Dahan/Invader land addition. Energy track has Air/Moon/Any; bottom track ends ANY Element, not unlimited card plays. Damage/Destroy becomes Fear 0/2/5 and Explorer/Town Push, once per Invader per Power; own Presence exception. Spirits May Yet Dream flips face-down Fear card and grants existing Element type; Night Terrors adds Fear.
Setup 2 Presence highest-numbered Sands; high complexity. Original artwork/track geometry independently corroborated by 2017 physical photo, with Any bottom-track fine print confirmed in crop.
Left/middle eight panels independently matched original facsimile art, Growth boxes, tracks and innate structure; right column excluded. Photo alone not used for unreadable fine print.
River artwork, Growth, track arrangement, special-rule/innate placement corroborate original printed panel. Too small for fine-print authority.
Bringer lower track ends ANY bonus Element; highest number remains 3 Card Plays; corroborates original full native panel track.

Setup shuffle/3-4-5 Invader stages, nine Fear cards and divider placement, board layouts and setup symbols/starting Presence/initial Explore. B&C render inspected solely for expansion corner-symbol membership legend.
Four-player standard two-row parallelogram, separate hands/discards, distinct Spirit starting boards and pre-populated setup pieces.
Threshold all-or-nothing/Instead, do-as-much-as-can, one land/turn/use and printed example target bars.
Printed iconography, slash unions, Range source icons, Spirit targets, track icons, phase order and direct official Living FAQ link.
